The Vendetta Gazette

Vol. XXII • September 7, 2026 • “All the Blood That’s Fit to Print” • Two Cents (If You’re Still Alive to Pay)

★ TERRITORY GAINS THIS WEEK ★ Wu-Tang              +166 turfs
Flattop               +55 turfs
Claude                +45 turfs

Wu-Tang — Unstoppable, Unrepentant, Insufferably Punctual

One Hundred and Sixty-Six More Turfs; Sir Caprice Stripped to the Bone; Your Correspondent Considers Early Retirement By Our Man in the Trenches, Ignatius P. Flambeau

This correspondent shall dispense entirely with the theatrical pretence of surprise. There shall be no gasps, no clutched pearls, no dramatically overturned inkwells. Wu-Tang, the Iron Fist of the East Side, has done it again — one hundred and sixty-six territorial captures this week alone, accompanied by eighty-three calculated raids upon the dwindling empire of the wretched Sir Caprice, stripping that unfortunate soul of a further one hundred and sixty-six turfs and eighty-three separate pillages of his cashboxes and armories. By this publication's arithmetic — and we employ only the finest arithmeticians, several of whom retain all their fingers — Sir Caprice has now surrendered three hundred and twenty-nine turfs to the Iron Fist across two consecutive weeks. One begins to wonder whether Sir Caprice is a criminal boss at all, or merely an unusually masochistic landlord.

The Iron Fist showed no deviation from his now-legendary method: systematic, merciless, and utterly devoid of theatrical flourish. He does not gloat. He does not grandstand. He simply takes. Vendetta City's underworld whispers that Wu-Tang conducts his territorial campaigns the way a glacier consumes a mountain — slowly, inevitably, and with no particular opinion about the mountain's feelings on the matter.

Flattop and Claude — Two New Wolves Baring Their Teeth

Ten HQ Conquests for Flattop; Claude's Eight-Stop Rampage Leaves Half a Dozen Bosses Homeless By Our Man in the Trenches, Ignatius P. Flambeau

While Wu-Tang continues his geological conquest of the city's eastern precincts, two ambitious lieutenants of the new generation have erupted upon the scene with a violence that has set the underworld's teeth chattering. Flattop — that flat-capped, square-jawed bruiser whose expression has reportedly never changed since birth — stormed a staggering ten enemy headquarters this week, netting himself a gain of fifty-five turfs and padding his garrison to a formidable seven hundred and ninety-eight hardened soldiers. He opened his account on August 26th by ejecting the unfortunate laaley from his command post, and followed twenty-four hours later by planting his colours over the ashes of Walrus's former stronghold. Walrus, it should be noted, has since vanished entirely from the rolls — one of seventeen players who evaporated from Vendetta City's ledgers this week like morning dew upon a freshly bloodied pavement.

Not to be outdone in the business of rendering bosses homeless, Claude — known in certain riverside establishments as “Claude the Broom” for his habit of sweeping entire neighbourhoods clean — executed eight headquarters captures in a single blistering forty-eight-hour stretch. Beginning on the 28th of August, he rolled through the command posts of Izubest123, huongman, Vizzyblue, daphne, Public Enemy, Web3ella, 65416, and a — the last of whom, this paper notes with some linguistic bewilderment, appears to have christened their criminal empire with a single letter of the alphabet. Whatever ambitions that initial may have represented, they are now conclusively full-stopped. Claude also found time to raid the vault of Kuklinski to the legal maximum — five hundred dollars cash and five hundred units of arms removed in a single, clean operation — before the poor wretch could so much as blink.
